expectations.text: Output contains a valid YAML config with a top-level 'tests' key
Metadata section includes platform: AWS and benchmark.keyword: cluster-density-v2
expectations.evidence: Uses 'benchmark: cluster-density-v2' (missing .keyword suffix). Also adds wrong top-level fields 'index' and 'benchmarkIndex' that don't exist in Orion schema.

expectations.text: Metadata includes masterNodesType, masterNodesCount, workerNodesType, workerNodesCount fields
expectations.evidence: Lines 7-10: all four node config fields present

expectations.text: API server CPU metric uses metricName: containerCPU with labels.namespace.keyword: openshift-kube-apiserver
expectations.evidence: Uses metricName: apiServerCPU (wrong — should be containerCPU). No labels.namespace.keyword filter at all.

expectations.text: etcd disk latency metric uses metricName: 99thEtcdDiskBackendCommitDurationSeconds
Pod ready latency metric uses metricName: podLatencyQuantilesMeasurement with quantileName: Ready
expectations.evidence: Uses metricName: podLatency (wrong name). Missing quantileName: Ready field entirely.

expectations.text: Metrics use the nested agg: structure with value and agg_type subfields (not flat 'aggregation')
expectations.evidence: Uses wrong agg structure: 'value: avg, agg_period: 5m' instead of correct 'value: cpu, agg_type: avg'

expectations.text: Each metric has a threshold and direction field
expectations.evidence: No threshold field on any metric. direction: 0 on all (should be 1 for increases-only)
